<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Instant Manifestation](/Classes.aspx?ID=18)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 51

**Class** Summoner
</column>

---

You can manifest your eidolon with incredible speed. You can use Manifest Eidolon as a single action, instead of a three-action activity
